paragraphs.text: The following characters from the Edge are only mentioned in flavor text or on legendary creature cards, appear as minor characters in the storyline , or are otherwise not notable enough to receive their own article.
Fleem is a villainous goblin -human hybrid created through gene-splicing by the evil scientist Goben.

Fleem is the Universes Within representation of Green Goblin ( Marvel's Spider-Man ). Players latched onto Fleem quite quickly after its preview as a meme. Jokes centered on the idea of turning Fleem into the game's mascot, with favorable comparisons being made to Loot . In a quick reaction, Wizards of the Coast made Fleem available as a purchasable Avatar , sleeve and emote sticker.

Surris is a human scientist in the Edge who developed spider silk-based technology. Using the technology, he became a hero , using a web gun attached to a backpack with spiders inside of it to combat a giant bird. He was introduced as the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart of Peter Parker // Amazing Spider-Man .
